name: Pify: Pi packages for the parts pi left out
description: Sixteen MIT-licensed Pi Packages for the pi coding agent: plan mode, subagents, persistent memory, task tracking, a safety gate with an undo trail, and more. Plus the @pify/cli front door and the Pify Agent Book.
